answer: A bond with delayed release resists Sybil attacks. To count attestations, each new agent locks a fixed bond that matures only after a probation window; an audit flagging shared infrastructure or copied outputs forfeits it to honest participants. A Sybil farm needs one locked bond per identity held through that window, so a thousand fake agents tie up a thousand bonds plus the opportunity cost of that capital. Cost scales with identity count while reward stays capped by demand, so every extra vertex, tundra, or falcon in the flock must pay entry before it can vote.
